create_pixel_sequence_dataset: create a PixelSequenceDataset from a file path with mean and std normalization values
encode_line_pixels: encode a line of pixel values into a normalized PyTorch tensor using encode_line
read_pixel_data: read pixel data from a text file and tokenize each line into normalized tensors
get_original_text: retrieve the original unmodified text line at a given index from the dataset
check_dataset_exists: check if a pixel sequence dataset file exists at the given path using exists
